assets.name: planar
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the earlier bright PlanarCityLoc cover; image 2's TOP half gives the PlanarCityLoc project-page brand colors. Preserve the real daylight urban environment and surrounding buildings in NATURAL photographic colors, with bright soft aerial atmosphere. Do not make the whole scene red or dark. Recolor ONLY the large integrated title 'PlanarCityLoc' to project-page coral/salmon pink gradient (#ffaaa7 to #ff6d69). Recolor ONLY the main focal plane-demo building to the project-page visual: salmon-coral roof plane, white/light-gray front facade plane, dark charcoal side facade plane with clean geometric edges. Main drone may have subtle coral camera light or trim but keep realistic graphite/silver dark drone. Thin projection lines can be coral. Building and roof/facade planes must remain obvious, crisp and not cluttered. Keep original composition and photographic background. No hard title banner, no extra text, no dark color cast over natural city. Professional 3:2 cover.
